planning_basis: Planner-owned decomposition reconciled through #105 and #118 after Admin README updates #103, #106 and #117, while preserving compatible verified work and live claims. README defines product requirements and high-level governance; roadmap phases, order, architecture, decomposition and release prerequisites remain Planner-owned below Admin and README authority. Worker scheduling/cursor mechanics remain operational HOW outside ROADMAP.
core_rule: Player advises -> AI Character decides -> Simulation validates -> World reacts.

baseline.public_policy: The stable public URL may serve an Admin-directed unverified development build when explicitly authorized. Independent Tester verification remains required before a build or phase is described as independently verified under normal autonomous progression.

phase_policy.origin_rule: Every new campaign begins at authoritative world coordinate (0,0) in the SEED-generated inhabited starting village, with the initial playable view centered on the campaign origin.
phase_policy.map_rule: Every cumulative phase must preserve and progressively extend the persistent living strategic world map as the primary playable surface. The visible tile region is only a local active part of the larger continuous world, not a finite complete map.
phase_policy.world_generation_rule: Compatible SEED + world coordinates + compatible generator rules reproduce the same unmodified base world. Base composition includes coherent terrain/water/roads/bridges, settlement archetype foundations, local populations and habitat/ecology foundations where applicable; neighboring regions remain deterministic and available without a gameplay-defined outer boundary.
phase_policy.persistence_rule: Deterministic unchanged base-world content may be regenerated from SEED and coordinates; authoritative campaign changes are persisted. The complete current-world composition may also include authoritative elapsed-time/off-screen progression.
phase_policy.real_time_rule: The campaign is real-time rather than turn-based. At normal speed 60 real-world minutes equal one 24-hour in-game day, so one in-game hour equals 2.5 real-world minutes.
phase_policy.day_night_rule: Authoritative game time defines dawn/daylight transition at 05:00 and darkness/night transition at 22:00. Moving physically accurate shadows are not required.
phase_policy.simulation_fidelity_rule: The protagonist's active/relevant region uses continuous high-detail simulation; inactive regions may use lower-cost authoritative elapsed-time progression/aggregation instead of freezing or full-detail ticking.
phase_policy.npc_life_rule: NPC routines may be time-aware and role/location dependent; simple varied deterministic/Local-BOT ambient NPC-to-NPC dialogue may respond to profession, settlement/location, environment, time and relevant local conditions without becoming authoritative truth by itself.
phase_policy.ecology_rule: Domestic/farm animals, wildlife and a broad original medieval-fantasy bestiary are SEED/habitat/context-aware simulation-backed world content where gameplay-relevant.
phase_policy.designer_rule: Every phase requires at least one independently testable Designer-role task before normal phase completion.
phase_policy.normal_phase_transition_rule: Under normal autonomous progression, an independent Worker acting in the Tester role must independently pass the active phase gate before the next phase activates. The Tester must not approve work produced by the same Worker identity. Explicit Admin instructions may override normal publication or phase/release workflow requirements without converting unverified work into verified work.

tile picking, hover, selection and non-authoritative inspection

roads, settlements, minimap and compatible localization
compatible textures, terrain rendering and organic elevation work
completed authoritative-state, seed/RNG, save/load, coordinate, terrain and origin-village foundations
live #111 NPC-presence work and live #112 sparse persistent-delta work within their approved focused scopes
ADAPT: existing world generation to add SEED-derived settlement/environment diversity, bridges and ecology/habitat foundations
basic local NPC routines into later time-aware daily schedules without changing the live #111 claim
existing persistence into a composition where sparse deltas remain separate from authoritative elapsed-time/off-screen progression
living-map presentation to reflect authoritative day/night state and active/off-screen world continuity
finite single-map assumptions into coordinate-addressed continuous regions
DEFER: deep profession economy, faction behavior and settlement management beyond the active-phase foundations
deep creature combat/faction AI beyond ecology foundation behavior
natural Advisor conversation and persistent Advisor influence beyond current R02 world foundations
future protagonist Local BOT and optional LLM character decision systems
rank progression, realm economy, diplomacy, military and imperial gameplay beyond the active phase
REJECT: legacy rules that override Admin or README authority
runtime behavior that gives the player binding direct control over the autonomous protagonist
visual assets or presentation state acting as authoritative simulation truth by themselves
hidden nondeterministic inputs controlling authoritative outcomes
a gameplay-defined finite outer world edge or disconnected random maps masquerading as one continuous world
turn-based world authority that freezes normal world progression until player turns
permanently frozen inactive regions when game time advances
ambient dialogue inventing authoritative world facts without simulation support
save behavior that silently loses meaningful persistent or elapsed-time world changes

phases.title: Strategic World Baseline Reconciliation and Stabilization
phases.completion: Dedicated Tester PHASE GATE PASS on current compatible descendant 893a38aec36c5e7a5b616d7968481a776aa3edd0; tracker and gate closed completed.

phases.title: Authoritative Unbounded Living World and Campaign State
phases.release_gate: Preserve verified seed/save/world foundations while establishing continuous unbounded coordinates; origin (0,0); deterministic region, settlement/environment and ecology base composition; authoritative real-time game clock; 05:00 dawn and 22:00 darkness; high-detail active-region life; lower-cost off-screen elapsed-time progression; time-aware NPC schedule/ambient-dialogue foundations; persistent world deltas; and coherent living-map presentation. Independent phase verification required before R03.

phases.title: Legal Action and World Interaction Validation
phases.release_gate: Add deterministic simulation-owned legality and interaction validation for spatial world actions and NPC/location/animal/creature interactions, using current time/location/world context without player result injection or direct execution; pass independent phase verification before R04.

phases.title: Autonomous Protagonist and Local BOT Core
phases.release_gate: Add the deterministic local character driver so the protagonist chooses valid goals/actions and travels through the continuous real-time world under Simulation authority, respecting time, locations, schedules and region transitions; independent phase verification required before R05.

phases.title: Conversation and Advisor Influence
phases.release_gate: Add natural advisor-character interaction so advice can influence observable protagonist decisions, travel and interactions in the same living real-time world without becoming binding direct control; independent phase verification required before R06.

phases.title: Memory, Trust and Relationships
phases.release_gate: Add persistent character memory, trust and relationship effects that influence autonomous decisions/interactions and remain coherent with elapsed world time, NPC life and cumulative world state; independent phase verification required before R07.

phases.title: Advisor Instruction Plain-Text System
phases.release_gate: Add structured human-readable persistent Advisor Instructions as an influence system, never as direct authority over simulation truth; independent phase verification required before R08.

phases.title: Optional LLM Adapter and Deterministic Fallback
phases.release_gate: Add an optional LLM driver for the same protagonist with privacy-conscious context boundaries and deterministic Local BOT fallback; authoritative real-time simulation and living-world behavior remain intact; independent phase verification required before R09.

phases.title: Peasant Survival, Jobs and Local Economy
phases.release_gate: Make the inhabited local world meaningfully playable through survival, work, resources, shops/services and profession-based NPC interactions whose availability/routines can respond to authoritative game time and local conditions; independent phase verification required before R10.

phases.title: Squire and Knight Progression
phases.release_gate: Add rank-appropriate training, patronage, duties, missions and progression while maintaining autonomous character choice, real-time schedules and continuous spatial world travel; independent phase verification required before R11.

phases.title: Settlement Diversity, Ecology, Factions, Trade and Diplomacy
phases.release_gate: Deepen the SEED-generated settlement/environment foundations into functionally and visually distinct villages, frontier/border/abandoned settlements, towns, cities and fortified/castle locations; deepen appropriate ecology; add factions, trade and diplomacy represented through the continuously living strategic world; independent phase verification required before R12.

phases.title: Court, Realm Economy, Military and Succession
phases.release_gate: Add higher-rank court, realm economy, strategic military and succession systems that continue to progress coherently through authoritative world time without direct unit-by-unit player control; independent phase verification required before R13.

phases.title: King, Multi-Kingdom and Emperor Endgame
phases.release_gate: Extend authoritative simulation and continuous living-world presentation to sovereign, multi-kingdom and imperial scale while preserving character autonomy, world-time continuity and readable causality; independent phase verification required before R14.

phases.title: Advanced Advisor Tools and Mini-Games
phases.release_gate: Add direct Advisor tools and mini-games that improve information or influence without bypassing character autonomy, game time or simulation authority; independent phase verification required before R15.

phases.title: Presentation, Accessibility, Balance and Campaign Release
phases.release_gate: Complete cumulative presentation, day/night readability, ecology/settlement coherence, accessibility, responsiveness, balance, performance and campaign-level regression across the unbounded real-time living strategic world; obtain independent Tester-role verification for the final normal release state.
